parts.article:
Good morning, Smart Travel, Jason speaking.

Hi, good morning. I saw your advert in today’s paper, about hot air balloon trips. It sounds pretty exciting. And I wonder how much it costs.

Well, the price may vary depending on the location, number of participants, and add-ons. A single ride may cost you up to £280 per person. But if you choose group booking, there is a discount. And the cheapest flight is £125 each, for a group booking of at least 10 people.

Oh, that’s not too bad. What do you mean by add-ons?

They are optional items, like taking photos for you during the ride, champagne, and sit down breakfast after the flight. Upon completing the trip, we will provide each participant with a certificate. And that is entirely free of charge.

Can I book a ride over the phone?

Yes, that’s an option. Reservations can be made one year ahead of your trip by telephone. But to pick a specific date, you must book online. A confirmation email will be sent to you right afterwards.

How high can the balloons go?

A hot air balloon’s height is limited by the temperature of the air, and how much fuel it can carry. And the highest altitude ever recorded for a ride is 1,800 metres. But most rides stay below 300 metres.

Oh boy, that’s impressive. How long is a single ride?

The average hot air balloon ride lasts about an hour. The entire ballooning experience, which includes ground preparation, flight and post-flight packing up and celebration, may take two to three hours.

And what time are the flights?

Our flights generally meet about an hour before sunrise on the day. You will be notified of the exact meeting time the evening before your flight. Night flights are avoided due to weather conditions.

Fair enough.

Which month do you recommend for a hot air balloon trip?

Autumn is the best time of year to take the trip. Not only can you see the changing hues of the trees from above, but it is a great way to spend time with the whole family before it gets too cold.

I see.

But please note that our flight may be cancelled, and you will be notified by phone the day before.

Why is that?

It can be quite dangerous to fly under bad weather conditions, like a thunderstorm. So our experienced pilots will not go under such conditions.

What should I wear for the ride?

We suggest wearing comfortable clothing, like a jacket. Multiple layers are always better. Wearing a helmet for safety concerns is also a good idea. Sandals are not permitted.

Can children or older people participate?

All children must be above the minimum age of 9 years old, and they have to be accompanied by at least a parent or guardian. However, an adult has no age limit as long as they meet the health requirements.

What exactly are the health requirements?

Participants must at least be in fair physical condition. For example, they shall have no significant knee, hip or back problems, and no recent surgeries or broken bones. They must also stand unassisted for an hour during the flight. It is the required position during the whole flight. As the balloon comes to land, all passengers will need to adopt the landing position with knees bent in front of them.

Are those rides safe?

Hot air balloon companies are required to have a commercial balloon pilot license, and all our pilots go through rigorous training before they are allowed to fly. It is a relatively gentle activity. However, the impact of a balloon landing can vary drastically, depending on factors like wind speed. Sometimes it is similar to the momentum of jumping off a small chair. If you cannot jump off a small chair, speaking to your doctor before booking a balloon flight is best.

Thank you very much. I think that's all I need to know. Thanks for calling. Goodbye.

analyses.content: 工作人员介绍说，如果是至少 10 人的团体预订，每个人最便宜的价格（cheapest flight）是 125 英镑。
A single ride may cost you up to £280 per person. But if you choose group booking, there is a discount. And the cheapest flight is £125 each, for a group booking of at least 10 people.
最高价 vs 最低价干扰！ 录音先提到了 up to £280（最高可达280），这是干扰项；题目问 lowest price，对应原文的 cheapest flight is £125。

They are optional items, like taking photos for you during the ride, champagne, and sit down breakfast after the flight. Upon completing the trip, we will provide each participant with a certificate. And that is entirely free of charge.
免费 vs 付费干扰！ 像 photos（拍照）和 champagne（香槟）通常是付费或可选的（optional），只有 certificate 被明确强调是 entirely free of charge（完全免费）。
旅行结束时，公司会给每位参与者免费颁发一张 certificate（证书）。
Yes, that’s an option. Reservations can be made one year ahead of your trip by telephone. But to pick a specific date, you must book online.
预订方式对比！ 电话（telephone）只能提前一年做普通预约，而定具体日子（pick a specific date）必须用 online，注意题目中的 only 对应原文的 must。
如果想要选择具体的日期（exact/specific date），客户必须通过 online（在线）方式进行预订。

A hot air balloon’s height is limited by the temperature of the air, and how much fuel it can carry. And the highest altitude ever recorded for a ride is 1,800 metres. But most rides stay below 300 metres.
数字干扰！ 不要填 300，原文说大多数飞行保持在 300 米以下（stay below），题目问的是 maximum（最大值）。
热气球飞行有记录的最高高度（maximum height/highest altitude）是 1,800 米。
Our flights generally meet about an hour before sunrise on the day. You will be notified of the exact meeting time the evening before your flight. Night flights are avoided due to weather conditions.
听到 flights 时间相关的内容时定位。原文的 avoided 对应题目的 no flights。
由于天气原因，night（夜间）的飞行是被避免/取消的（are avoided）。
工作人员推荐 autumn（秋天）是一年中最好的飞行季节，因为可以从空中看到树木颜色的变化。
Which month do you recommend for a hot air balloon trip? Autumn is the best time of year to take the trip. Not only can you see the changing hues of the trees from above...
听到 recommend 或 best time 后捕捉季节词。注意 Autumn 的拼写（末尾有 n）。
It can be quite dangerous to fly under bad weather conditions, like a thunderstorm. So our experienced pilots will not go under such conditions.
原文说的是单数 a thunderstorm。
遇到恶劣天气如 a thunderstorm（雷暴）时，飞行可能会被取消。
We suggest wearing comfortable clothing, like a jacket. Multiple layers are always better. Wearing a helmet for safety concerns is also a good idea. Sandals are not permitted.
推荐 vs 禁止！ 题目问建议穿戴什么。排除 sandals（凉鞋），因为原文说 Sandals are not permitted（不被允许）。
除了夹克，工作人员建议为了安全起见，最好也戴上 helmet（头盔）。

All children must be above the minimum age of 9 years old, and they have to be accompanied by at least a parent or guardian. However, an adult has no age limit as long as they meet the health requirements.
听到 adult 后定位。题目 no ... restriction 对应原文的 no age limit。
虽然儿童有最小年龄限制，但对于成年人来说没有 age（年龄）上限，只要身体健康即可。

They must also stand unassisted for an hour during the flight. It is the required position during the whole flight. As the balloon comes to land, all passengers will need to adopt the landing position...
动作辨析！ 题目强调 throughout the flight（整个飞行过程）。排除 landing position（着陆姿势）要求的 knees bent（弯膝盖）。
参与者必须能够在整个飞行过程中保持 stand（站立）姿势且无需他人协助。
